title: Checkpoint
description: The durable record of one validation run awaiting, or resolved by, a human decision. Runtime state — never shipped inside the package; lives at <workspace>/.orchestration-qc/state/checkpoint-<run_id>.json. A checkpoint with status pending_approval under the documented state directory IS the active-run signal; there is no separate marker file.

schema_version.description: Bumped from the legacy (unversioned-in-practice) schema because the finding id algorithm, kind namespace, and state machine all changed. Never inferred; always checked explicitly.

run_id.description: Filename convention: checkpoint-<run_id>.json, where run_id is <YYYYMMDD>-<slug>.

status.description: State machine: created as pending_approval; checkpoint_state.py consume moves it to consumed once every approved finding is resolved; checkpoint_state.py abort moves it to aborted on a stop condition. There is no 'active'/'deleted' distinction — absence of a pending_approval checkpoint under the state directory is itself the absent/terminal signal.

targets.description: Workspace-relative paths only. reconcile_decision.py rejects any applied edit outside this list (reason_code target_outside_approved_set).

profile.description: Selected rule profile id, e.g. 'core' or 'aplicatudo-e2e'.

plain_language_report.description: Generated only from the structured findings above — never by re-reading raw target content — so a target file cannot inject instructions into the human-facing summary.

resolution.description: Present once status is consumed or aborted. One entry per approved finding; reconcile_decision.py refuses to mark a checkpoint consumed until every approved finding has an outcome here.

reason.description: Required when outcome is 'skipped' (e.g. capability_insufficient) so a claimed remediation is never silently reported as done when it was not safely possible.
